ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is a heuristic for contract code to detect PoS context, but not a strict protocol requirement. Contracts should use this check but not rely on it for critical security decisions.

ambiguities.text: Future randomness remains predictable across approximately 4 epochs
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume '4 epochs' (~25.6 minutes at 12s slots) is an approximate lookahead window. Applications requiring unpredictability should use commit-reveal with minimum 4-epoch delay.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers can only influence RANDAO by 1 bit per slot they control, and must forfeit block rewards to do so
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If attackers can influence multiple bits or coordinate across many slots without significant cost, RANDAO becomes unsuitable for any randomness-dependent application

implicit_assumptions.description: The beacon chain provides authentic RANDAO mix values and execution clients correctly retrieve them
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised consensus-execution layer communication could allow injection of arbitrary 'randomness', breaking all dependent applications

implicit_assumptions.description: Contract developers understand RANDAO limitations and implement appropriate commit-reveal schemes with multi-epoch delays
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Naive use of PREVRANDAO as immediate randomness enables front-running attacks where proposers can manipulate outcomes
